name: Questar Southern System 2005 Expansion
researcher_notes: No Questar row exists in the gas snapshot, so this is not a match to an existing row. The EIA pipeline projects release for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 374, lists Questar Southern Sys 2005 Expansion as completed in November 2005 in Utah: 18.7 miles, 24 inch, 102 MMcf/d added, cost 54.6 million dollars, FERC docket CP05-05. 18.7 miles is about 30.1 km, above the 25 km floor. Only the EIA release was confirmed. A web search for an independent FERC or operator source could not be run because of a session limit, so this is one source and medium confidence. Start and end points were not found. Route not researched. Parent name: no Questar system row exists, so the operator name was used as the pipeline name and needs a ruling.
